FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Wisconsin fishing licence

Most anglers aged 16 or older need a fishing licence. A normal one-day licence still needs a trout or salmon stamp for those species.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Residents and visitors aged 16 or older, unless exempt.

Who doesn’t

  • Children aged 15 or younger.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident 1-daynon residentSelected day, ending at midnight$15 USD
Non-resident 4-daynon resident4 days$29 USD
Non-resident 15-daynon resident15 days$33 USD
Non-resident annualnon residentAnnual$55 USD
Great Lakes 2-day, with salmon/trout stampany2 days$14 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Inland Trout Stamp · $10 USD
    Required for inland trout fishing unless exempt.
  • Great Lakes Salmon/Trout Stamp · $10 USD
    Required for Great Lakes trout or salmon unless exempt or included in the licence.

Rules visitors should know

  • The two-day Great Lakes licence includes its salmon/trout stamp.
  • Sturgeon harvest uses separate licences and season rules.

How to buy

Use Go Wild online or a DNR licence vendor.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Wisconsin?

Most anglers aged 16 or older need a fishing licence. A normal one-day licence still needs a trout or salmon stamp for those species.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Wisconsin?

Non-resident 1-day: $15 USD; Non-resident 4-day: $29 USD; Non-resident 15-day: $33 USD; Non-resident annual: $55 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Wisconsin?

Use Go Wild online or a DNR licence vendor.
